question: How will I know what to do, what to expect, and how to plan for my fair?
answer: We will guide you every step of the way. Our Guide to a Successful Ignatius Book Fair covers every step you need to run a great fair. If you like to have a one-stop shop, this guide will be a wonderful resource. Our emails will break it down into bite-sized nuggets every ten days or so leading up to your fair, giving you an opportunity to take small action steps toward executing a successful fair. Our three-part workshop series will feature live, interactive help with our book fair managers, taking the guide and breaking it down into three key areas. You will have a chance to ask questions during these workshops, you'll know you're on schedule, and you'll get to see real-life examples of a fair coming together from start to finish. Lastly, our book fair managers and customer support team are here to help.

question: When will my books and materials arrive?
answer: Your books and other materials will arrive one week before your fair, if not earlier. They will arrive via UPS and in most cases, we will send you a tracking number once the materials have left our warehouse. This will give you time to plan for having staff on hand to accept the shipment and store it until you are ready to set up.

question: What arrives with my shipment?
answer: Your shipment will include all books and other items available for sale, two point-of-sale payment devices, two external credit card readers, book fair flyers to send home before the fair, table category signs, book stands to help display titles, five decorative posters, tablecloths in our colors of mint green, yellow, and orange, and bookmarks.

question: What if something arrives damaged?
answer: We apologize if anything arrives in less-than-ideal condition! If so, please take a picture and send it to your book fair manager right away. She will instruct you on what to do.

question: What other materials might I need for my fair that aren't included?
answer: We don't send these items, but we recommend bags so customers can carry their purchases home, a cash box with change for those paying in cash, a notebook at your checkout station to record any events you need clarification on later, packing tape for repacking books once your fair concludes, a Sharpie marker, and any additional décor to make your fair come alive. For décor, we suggest balloons, twinkle lights, streamers, or a fun theme. Book fairs are wonderful events for children — and core, happy memories. Anything you can do to make the fair more memorable and fun is a bonus — appreciated by all.

question: What payments can we accept? How is it recorded?
answer: The payment devices can ring up transactions paid in cash, check, credit card, or the FACTS system (if applicable). For FACTS transactions, the payment device will ask for the child or family name and attach it to the amount owed. Your business department will then manually charge those accounts accordingly.

question: Who does the customer make out the check to?
answer: All checks will be made out to your organization, deposited into your account, and held until you receive our invoice, which typically arrives 2–3 weeks after your fair ends.

question: If we are tax-exempt, why do customers have to pay sales tax?
answer: If your organization is tax-exempt, it will not pay sales tax on books purchased by and for it. Your customers are still obligated to pay sales tax as determined by your local, state, and federal tax laws. The tax rate for your area will be automatically calculated by the handheld payment device where applicable. After the fair, when making purchases for your organization using your reward dollars, you will not be assessed tax if we have your tax-exempt certificate on file.

question: What happens if we run out of a title or item during the fair?
answer: We have a system in place to make this a non-issue. Our Last Copy Procedure, coupled with our Ship to School Spreadsheet, are designed to maximize your fair's success — and we'll walk you through both in detail. Essentially, any item we currently sell can be requested at the checkout station, paid for at that time, and delivered to your school approximately fourteen business days after your fair concludes.

question: How long do I have to close out the fair once it has ended?
answer: You will have three days to gather everything up, choose books to keep with your rewards dollars, pack up the rest, and schedule a pickup.

question: How do we send unsold items back?
answer: Included in our closing instructions is a link for you to fill out. Once you finish packing everything up, let us know how many boxes you are returning, and we will email you return labels to tape to the boxes. You can also choose a pickup date 2–3 days later for UPS to collect your boxes.

question: When can we expect ordered items to arrive once the fair is over?
answer: We are as excited as you are to get your orders out quickly. It typically takes about fourteen business days for our team to reconcile your order and ship it.

question: If a customer has ordered online, how are rewards calculated? Where is the order sent?
answer: During your in-person fair, customers will also have an opportunity to shop online. All online orders will be held until your fair ends and shipped out quickly once it concludes. If the customer has chosen your school as the delivery address, all orders will arrive in a box (or boxes), together, individually labeled for each customer. All online orders earn rewards equaling thirty percent of the item list price in Ave Dollars. You can use these Ave Dollars to purchase books for your organization. There is no cash-back option for online purchases.

question: When will I receive an invoice?
answer: Once your fair is over and your returns have been received, our accounting team will begin preparing your invoice. It will reflect the money your organization accepted via cash, check, and FACTS (credit card payments are automatically sent to us). It will also specify the check amount owed. This total will vary depending on whether you choose to receive your rewards in Ave Dollars or cash. You should expect to receive your invoice about three weeks after your fair ends. Need help? We're here for you. Call or email us any time — before, during, or after your fair. question: How will I know what to do, what to expect, and how to plan for my virtual fair?
answer: We will guide you through every step of the way. Our Guide to a Successful Virtual Fair covers every step you need to run a great fair. If you like to have a one-stop shop, this guide will be a wonderful resource. Our emails will break the guide down into bite-sized nuggets leading up to your virtual fair — giving you a chance to take small, manageable steps toward a successful event. Our live workshop will feature all the same information in an interactive live format that will give you an are having virtual fairs at the same time as you. Lastly, our book fair managers and customer support team are here to help.

question: If I ordered a box of sample books, when should I expect that to arrive?
answer: Your box of sample books will arrive one week before your scheduled fair dates. Please use these books to make a display for your community to interact with.

question: What other materials might I need for my fair that aren't included?
answer: Virtual fairs are very easy and do not require many extra materials. If you have balloons or twinkle lights to make your book display extra fun, that will be a bonus. Additionally, you can print any of our flyers and advertising materials directly from our page: Virtual Book Fair Resources.

question: If we did not order a box of sample books, can we still set up a display?
answer: Yes! You likely opted out of a box of sample books because you have some Ignatius Book Fairs books already on hand. Please use the website to ensure we still offer those titles, and then make your own display. Use this display as a mini advertising campaign for what your community will find and enjoy on our website.

question: What payment methods are accepted for purchases during a virtual fair?
answer: All shopping will be done entirely online. Currently, we accept credit cards only: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and American Express.

question: Is there a shipping fee for the customer?
answer: Customers have two shipping options: free shipping to your organization during the fair, or free shipping anywhere in the United States when the total before tax exceeds $15.

question: If we are tax exempt, why are customers charged sales tax?
answer: If your organization is tax-exempt, it will not pay sales tax on purchases made by and for it. Your customers are still obligated to pay sales tax according to the tax laws in your city and state. The appropriate tax rate will be calculated automatically at the time of purchase.

question: How will we know that a sale has been made?
answer: Your Ave (pronounced Ah-vey) Dollar administrator will see an increase in Ave Dollars earned each morning if a sale has been made during the fair. This total automatically increases after each sale. Your organization will earn 30% of the net total (before tax) in Ave Dollars rewards.

question: How do we know how many rewards we have earned?
answer: Your Ave Dollar administrator will see the total each morning after logging into the site with their signup email.

question: How are rewards calculated?
answer: You will earn rewards on each sale. Ave Dollars rewards are calculated at 30% of the items sold, before tax. For instance, if the item total is $100 before tax, your organization will earn $30 in Ave Dollars once the purchase is complete. New totals are deposited into the Ave Dollars administrator's account each morning.

question: Are Ave Dollar rewards the same value as dollars?
answer: Yes! Although you cannot exchange Ave Dollars for cash, they behave like cash on our site. If you have earned $100 in Ave Dollars, you can purchase $100 worth of books.

question: Can I cash in my Ave Dollars rewards for cash?
answer: No — Ave Dollars earned during online purchases cannot be redeemed for cash. Need help? We're here for you. Call our customer support line before, during, or after your fair. Available 7 am ET – 9 pm PT 888-771-2321

question: How long does it take for an order to ship?
answer: All orders placed during your fair and designated shipped to your organization will begin arriving together approximately 7–10 days after your fair closes. All other orders placed before, during, or after your fair that are shipped directly to the customer will ship immediately after fulfillment. It usually takes about 7 days to arrive.

question: When orders arrive at our organization, how do we know who they belong to?
answer: Each order will be individually packaged and labeled with the customer's name. They will arrive in a box or series of boxes starting approximately 7–10 days after your fair closes.

question: Who can I call if I have an issue before, during, or after the fair?
answer: You can call our customer support line at 888-771-2321. We have someone available from 7 am ET – 9 pm PT .
